Name: Crystal Refiner
Author: Omegasis
Description:
This mod adds a simple machine known as the Crystal Refiner which is used to increase the quality of gems and minerals, making them more profitable to sell. 

The recipe for the crystal refiner can be unlocked [spoiler] from the Dwarf's shop for 10,000g.[/spoiler]

It takes 3 in-game days to refine any mineral or gem regardless of the sell price.

This mod should be compatible with modded minerals and gems as well.

Downloads.Description: Updated the mod's manifest to require the latest Stardust Core and SMAPI versions.
